sources.title: GitHub - RajatRawat-creator/DistillDetect
sources.snippet: This repository is a release of the code used in our paper on detecting whether a student LLM was distilled from a given teacher. The pipeline runs end-to-end in four stages: Generate teacher responses (generation/) — one of four base teachers (Gemma-3-27B-it, GPT-OSS-120B, Qwen-3-8B, Nvidia-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct) answers an OMI / s1 prompt set via vLLM. Train controlled student models ...
